summary: PolyPid Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K containing a press release with a corporate update and first quarter 2026 financial results. The filing details progress on regulatory submissions for D-PLEX, including an ongoing rolling NDA with the FDA and planned MAA with the EMA, along with late-stage U.S. commercialization partnership discussions. No material definitive agreement, transaction, or special-situation event is announced. This is a routine periodic update by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a domestic earnings or operational press release, not a special situation.
